title: Uniform Shapley subset distribution
statement: For each natural number $n$, let $S$ be a random subset of $\\{0,1,\\ldots,n-1\\}$. Its distribution is obtained by choosing a size uniformly from $0$ through $n$, then choosing uniformly among all subsets of that size.
